title: Aurora Healthworks shiftboard kiosk handoff diary
content:
Meeting notes / quick brain dump — Aurora Healthworks kiosk + ShiftBoard integration (on‑prem)

Call date: 2026-02-26 10:00 PT
Attendees: Priya Nair (Redwood CS), Owen Gallagher (Redwood Solutions Eng), Luis Martinez (Redwood SRE), Dr. Elena Park (Aurora CTO), Raj Patel (Aurora IT), Maya Singh (Aurora Nursing ops)

High level ask
- Clinic wants a patient-checkin kiosk for community clinics (5 sites initially).
- Must run entirely inside Aurora network (PHI), pref on-prem or VPC with strict KMS/HSM controls. No hosted inference for PHI.
- Integrate with ShiftBoard (scheduling) and internal EHR via FHIR sync.
- Support voice-assisted intake (speech→transcript→LLM) and text fallback.

Key constraints called out by Aurora
- PHI never leaves VPC. BAA required — legal loops already started (HIPAA-BPA-77).
- Audit logs retention: 7 years minimal for triage records; they want append-only audit trail.
- Latency SLO: perceived interactive latency < 2s for UI (they want sub-1s for small OTAs, but we recommended 1.5–2s typical given voice + model).
- Token budget: average intake ~ 350–600 tokens (transcript + context). Max session 2,000 tokens before archiving.
- Model family: prefer smaller, medically fine-tuned model for safety (we suggested rdx-med-small / 4-bit quant).
- Hardware: constrained server room at sites 1–2 with RTX A5000 equivalent; want a lightweight appliance for edge sites (we proposed Redwood Private on dedicated GPUs).

Technical specifics / gotchas from the call
- ShiftBoard API uses an auth token that rotates daily for them; time windows and timezone conversions were brittle on earlier pilots. Need robust timezone normalization and caching of availability.
- EHR mapping: patient IDs sometimes duplicated across legacy clinics — must use multi-field dedupe (name + DOB + phone) and fallback heuristic.
- Voice pipeline: they want on-device noise suppression, then transcription using vendor X. Transcripts need redaction step before any external call; but since inference is on-prem, we still run a redaction pass for QA/audit.
- KV cache behavior: long-tail prompts (repeat visits) could benefit from prefix caching; watch memory usage per GPU for 2k seq lengths.
- Model warmup: first-cold request to model after nightly maintenance spikes latency; schedule warmups before clinic hours.
- Quantization: 4-bit int8/4 combos looked promising in our bench, but their exact GPUs may need a custom kernel fallback — add to infra checklist.
- Fallbacks: if local model overloaded, policy must NOT send PHI to hosted fallback. Instead show degraded UX (static answers, schedule-only flows).

Operational notes
- Provisioning: site images should include Docker image + Nix-based config for reproducible runtime. Use customer KMS integration for disk encryption.
- Observability: per-session tracing IDs + token-level cost attribution expected. Aurora wants weekly cost reports and daily error summaries during pilot.
- Rollout plan: pilot at site-01 (low traffic) → site-02 → gradual week-by-week ramp. Canary policy: 10% sessions on new model variant for 48h, then 50% for 24h.

Open questions to resolve (assigned)
- (Priya) Confirm legal sign-off timeline on BAA and audit retention (target: 2026-03-05).
- (Owen) Exact GPU spec at site-02 (do we need to propose alternative quant profile?) — due 2026-03-08.
- (Luis) Build local de-id pipeline: list of PHI fields to scrub or tokenize; meet with Aurora security 2026-03-02.
- (Raj/Aurora) Can they permit limited outbound checks to update model weights (meta telemetry) or is zero egress required?

Immediate next steps (short-term)
- Ship a short prescriptive runbook (1-pager) for on-prem appliance install; include required ports, disk layout, and KMS steps. (owner: Priya — draft by 2026-03-01)
- Open infra ticket INF-4720 to track quant/kernel work and kernel fallback tests. (owner: Luis)
- Prepare demo video (5–7min) of local kiosk flow using redwood-private + rdx-med-small and upload to Confluence. (owner: Owen — 2026-03-10)
- Schedule 30min follow-up with Aurora security to validate audit trail format and retention (owner: Priya — invite by 2026-03-03)

Prototype prompt examples (for evaluation suite)
- System: "You are the clinic intake assistant. Ask clarifying Qs to complete patient registration and check for urgent symptoms. Keep questions concise and friendly."
- Example user transcript (raw): "Hi I'm John Doe, I have a cough and my chest hurts a bit, my DOB 01/02/1984, phone 555-1212"
- Post-redaction prompt sent to model (example): "[REDACTED_NAME], DOB:[REDACTED_DOB], summary: cough + chest pain, ask 3 clarifying q to triage severity and collect consent for notes."
- Success criteria: triage intent correct 95% on holdout set; no PHI leaked in model completions; completion length <= 400 tokens for typical flows.

Risks / mitigation
- Risk: accidental egress of PHI via telemetry. Mitigation: strict egress firewall policy and redact at-source; disable auto-telemetry until BAA signed.
- Risk: user frustration when fallback kicks in (no model). Mitigation: graceful UX with clear messaging and ability to book by phone.

Notes to self
- Keep prompts conservative and ask for explicit consent to store notes.
- Add a small eval harness that simulates duplicate patient IDs & timezone mismatches.
- Check earlier pilot notebooks for noise suppression config (see linked PR).

Action items (short list)
- Draft install runbook (Priya)
- Open INF-4720 and HIPAA-BPA-77 tracking (Luis/Priya)
- Kernel/quant test matrix on A5000/RTX-6000 (Owen)
- Security sync + audit CSV schema (Priya + Aurora Sec)

Raw call transcript snippets (copied verbatim)
- Dr. Park: "We cannot in good faith send PHI to any public endpoint — that's a hard no."
- Raj: "ShiftBoard tokens rotate and sometimes timeouts make the schedule stale — we need a cached fallback for 15 min."
- Maya: "If the kiosk asks the same question twice patients get anxious — flow needs to detect prior answers quickly."

End of dump — will refine into a 1-pager and add to Confluence.

References: Confluence page and JIRA tickets in linked_artifacts.

-- Priya
